```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof gf_toy_rho = Inputs.range([0, 0.95], { step: 0.01, value: 0.9, label: LANG === "zh" ? "A 与 B 的相关系数 ρ" : "Correlation ρ between A and B" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Illustrative toy (not paper estimates). Characteristic ruler Q = [[1, ρ], [ρ, 1]]; a = (1, 0), b = (0, 1);
// priced direction g ∝ (1, 1), scaled to unit Q-length. Share of g explained by the
// span of v, scored with Q: (v'Qg)^2 / (v'Qv · g'Qg). For a and for b alone: (1 + ρ)/2. For b net of a, b - ρa: (1 - ρ)/2.
// Both rows of the bar chart are scored with the characteristic ruler; only the split differs.
gf_toy_calc = {
  const r = gf_toy_rho
  return {
    r,
    shareA: (1 + r) / 2,
    shareB: (1 + r) / 2,
    shareBnet: (1 - r) / 2,
    g: [1 / Math.sqrt(2 * (1 + r)), 1 / Math.sqrt(2 * (1 + r))]
  }
}
gf_toy_curve = (q) => Array.from({ length: 181 }, (_, i) => {
  const th = (i * 2) * Math.PI / 180, c = Math.cos(th), s = Math.sin(th)
  const k = 1 / Math.sqrt(q(c, s))
  return { x: c * k, y: s * k }
})
gf_toy_circle = gf_toy_curve((c, s) => c * c + s * s)
gf_toy_ellipse = gf_toy_curve((c, s) => c * c + s * s + 2 * gf_toy_rho * c * s)
gf_toy_L = LANG === "zh"
  ? { wa: "特征 A 的权重", wb: "特征 B 的权重", g: "定价方向",
      plain: "普通尺子（欧氏度量）", char: "特征尺子（格拉姆度量）",
      rowPlain: "用普通尺子分块", rowChar: "用特征尺子分块",
      blockA: "A（第一个因子）", blockB: "B（第二个因子）", share: "被解释的定价方向占比",
      ariaLeft: "图 1 左图：特征 A 与 B 的权重平面",
      ariaLeftDesc: (r) => `相关系数 ρ 为 ${r}。图中画出分别用普通尺子（虚线圆）和特征尺子（实线椭圆）量得大小为 1 的方向，以及 A、B 的权重箭头和定价方向。`,
      ariaRight: "图 1 右图：两种分块各自解释的定价方向占比",
      ariaRightDesc: (p) => `两行都用特征尺子计分。用普通尺子分块，两块合计声称解释了定价方向的 ${p}%；用特征尺子分块，合计为 100%。`,
      headline: (r) => r < 0.005
        ? "无论用哪把尺子量，A 与 B 都互不相关（ρ = 0）。"
        : `用普通尺子量，A 与 B 互不相关；用特征尺子量，两者${r >= 0.5 ? "高度" : "部分"}重叠（ρ = ${r.toFixed(2)}）。`,
      detail: (p) => `用普通尺子分块，两块合计声称解释了定价方向的 ${p}%；用特征尺子分块，合计始终为 100%。作为参照，美国数据中相关程度最高的一对特征，相关系数为 0.94（表 5，第 30 页）。` }
  : { wa: "Weight on characteristic A", wb: "Weight on characteristic B", g: "priced direction",
      plain: "Plain ruler (Euclidean metric)", char: "Characteristic ruler (Gram metric)",
      rowPlain: "Split with the plain ruler", rowChar: "Split with the characteristic ruler",
      blockA: "A (first factor)", blockB: "B (second factor)", share: "Share of the priced direction explained",
      ariaLeft: "Figure 1, left panel: weights on characteristics A and B",
      ariaLeftDesc: (r) => `Shows, for correlation ρ = ${r}, the directions of size 1 under the plain ruler (dashed circle) and under the characteristic ruler (solid ellipse), with the weight arrows for A and B and the priced direction.`,
      ariaRight: "Figure 1, right panel: share of the priced direction explained under each split",
      ariaRightDesc: (p) => `Both rows are scored with the characteristic ruler. Split with the plain ruler, the two blocks together claim ${p} percent of the priced direction; split with the characteristic ruler, they claim 100 percent.`,
      headline: (r) => r < 0.005
        ? "A and B are unrelated under both rulers (ρ = 0)."
        : `Unrelated under the plain ruler; ${r >= 0.5 ? "heavily" : "partly"} overlapping under the characteristic ruler (ρ = ${r.toFixed(2)}).`,
      detail: (p) => `Split with the plain ruler, the two blocks together claim ${p}% of the priced direction; split with the characteristic ruler, the total stays at 100%. For reference, the most correlated pair of characteristics in the U.S. data has ρ = 0.94 (Table 5, p. 30).` }
gf_toy_total = Math.round((1 + gf_toy_rho) * 100)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
gf_toy_geometry = () => Plot.plot({
  width: 300, height: 300, marginLeft: 44, marginBottom: 40,
  style: { fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: 12 },
  ariaLabel: gf_toy_L.ariaLeft,
  ariaDescription: gf_toy_L.ariaLeftDesc(gf_toy_rho.toFixed(2)),
  x: { domain: [-2.2, 2.2], label: gf_toy_L.wa, ticks: 5 },
  y: { domain: [-2.2, 2.2], label: gf_toy_L.wb, ticks: 5 },
  clip: true,
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleX([0], { stroke: palette.rule }),
    Plot.ruleY([0], { stroke: palette.rule }),
    Plot.line(gf_toy_circle, { x: "x", y: "y", stroke: palette.muted, strokeDasharray: "4 3" }),
    Plot.line(gf_toy_ellipse, { x: "x", y: "y", stroke: palette.naipca_iab, strokeWidth: 1.8 }),
    Plot.arrow([{ x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: 1, y2: 0 }, { x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: 0, y2: 1 }], { x1: "x1", y1: "y1", x2: "x2", y2: "y2", stroke: palette.qz_ipca, strokeWidth: 2, headLength: 8 }),
    Plot.arrow([{ x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: gf_toy_calc.g[0], y2: gf_toy_calc.g[1] }], { x1: "x1", y1: "y1", x2: "x2", y2: "y2", stroke: "#222", strokeWidth: 2, headLength: 8 }),
    Plot.text([{ x: 1.18, y: 0.16, t: "A" }, { x: 0.16, y: 1.2, t: "B" }], { x: "x", y: "y", text: "t", fill: palette.qz_ipca, fontWeight: 600 }),
    Plot.text([{ x: gf_toy_calc.g[0] + 0.12, y: gf_toy_calc.g[1] + 0.12, t: gf_toy_L.g }], { x: "x", y: "y", text: "t", fill: "#222", textAnchor: "start" })
  ]
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
gf_toy_rows = [
  { row: gf_toy_L.rowPlain, block: gf_toy_L.blockA, share: gf_toy_calc.shareA },
  { row: gf_toy_L.rowPlain, block: gf_toy_L.blockB, share: gf_toy_calc.shareB },
  { row: gf_toy_L.rowChar, block: gf_toy_L.blockA, share: gf_toy_calc.shareA },
  { row: gf_toy_L.rowChar, block: gf_toy_L.blockB, share: gf_toy_calc.shareBnet }
]
gf_toy_bars = () => Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(420, Math.max(280, width - 340)), height: 220, marginLeft: 12, marginRight: 40, marginTop: 28, marginBottom: 48,
  style: { fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: 12 },
  ariaLabel: gf_toy_L.ariaRight,
  ariaDescription: gf_toy_L.ariaRightDesc(gf_toy_total),
  x: { domain: [0, 2], label: gf_toy_L.share, labelAnchor: "center", labelOffset: 36, tickFormat: (d) => `${Math.round(d * 100)}%`, ticks: 5 },
  y: { label: null, axis: null, domain: [gf_toy_L.rowPlain, gf_toy_L.rowChar], padding: 0.55 },
  color: { domain: [gf_toy_L.blockA, gf_toy_L.blockB], range: [palette.naipca_iab, palette.ipca], legend: true },
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(gf_toy_rows, Plot.stackX({ y: "row", x: "share", fill: "block", insetLeft: 1, insetRight: 1 })),
    Plot.text([gf_toy_L.rowPlain, gf_toy_L.rowChar], { y: (d) => d, x: 0, text: (d) => d, dy: -20, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#222" }),
    Plot.ruleX([1], { stroke: "#222", strokeDasharray: "3 3" }),
    Plot.text(gf_toy_rows.filter((_, i) => i % 2 === 1), { y: "row", x: (d) => gf_toy_calc.shareA + d.share, text: (d) => `${Math.round((gf_toy_calc.shareA + d.share) * 100)}%`, dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fill: "#222", fontWeight: 600 })
  ]
})
```
